entries.violation_key: save_invoice(p_invoice jsonb, p_items jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: Verified live 2026-07-20 as a transitive-gate false positive. The authenticated SECURITY DEFINER provenance wrapper's only pre-delegation DML is a transaction-local mutation claim; it delegates in the same transaction to `_save_invoice_split_provenance_impl_20260719`, which binds `auth.uid()`, requires an active admin or sales_rep, enforces customer and salesman scope for sales reps, and only then reaches the canonical writer. entries.violation_key: cancel_delivery(p_delivery_id uuid, p_cancel_reason text, p_performed_by uuid, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: Re-reviewed live pg_get_functiondef 2026-10-20 (America/Chicago; read 2026-10-21 UTC) after replay-binding batch 3b (20261019235000, ledger 20261021024020) put a wrapper in front of the renamed body. The public wrapper binds v_actor := auth.uid() in its DECLARE, raises IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED without a key, refuses a NULL auth.uid() ('authentication required'), refuses a non-null p_performed_by that differs from v_actor ('actor mismatch'), and requires an active admin or sales_rep profile for v_actor BEFORE check_idempotency_intent can replay anything; it fingerprints auth.uid() as actor_id, never p_performed_by. It then passes p_performed_by (NULL or equal to auth.uid()) to the postgres-only _cancel_delivery_replay_impl_20261015, which repeats the same auth.uid() / mismatch refusals (its own message is 'ACTOR_MISMATCH: actor mismatch' since 20261102140000, ledger 20261102174004, which also refuses a completed delivery; re-pinned from live 2026-11-02), derives v_actor := COALESCE(p_performed_by, auth.uid()) (necessarily the caller), role-gates it again, and attributes every inventory, order, invoice, delivery, audit and activity write to that v_actor. The flag is predicate shape noise (the refusal compares v_actor IS DISTINCT FROM p_performed_by, with the parameter on the right, so the refusal-head pattern does not strip it), not an actor-forgery hole. The actor-forgery-fin-audit exception for this function was removed the same day: the new wrapper writes no financial_audit_log row and is no longer flagged there. Pins: the wrapper, the renamed body it delegates to, and auth.uid(); neither body calls is_admin()/is_sales_rep() (direct profiles role query), so no helper pin applies. Exception matches only the reviewed suspect parameter and exact function/dependency definition, owner, and effective EXECUTE contracts; missing or changed contracts leave the finding visible. Superseded review (2026-09-12, pre-wrapper body, md5 21da58c0c8f22d933ddd6938f5927194): same actor derivation and role gate.
